title: FakeVanish
description: A simple Vanish plugin. This plugin is designed to hide the server admin panel using the /va command. When Vanish is enabled, the boss panel is displayed.
body: This plugin is designed to hide the server's admin panel using the /va command. When Vanish is enabled, the boss bar is displayed. Permissions for the group must be granted in luckperms for the plugin to work correctly. It's also worth noting that permissions must be granted strictly in ascending order, so that those with lower permissions won't be able to see those with higher permissions. The plugin is in Russian, but can be changed to English in the config.
